summary: Vizsla Silver Corp. filed a Form 6-K on May 21, 2026, announcing executive appointments: Guillermo Hernandez as Vice President, Exploration and Jesus Velador's promotion to Chief Geologist, effective immediately. The filing discloses no financial terms or shareholder vote. The board approved the changes; no advisors are named. Structurally routine officer-level appointments without contest or forced departure. News release highlights backgrounds and district potential. What to watch: exploration strategy shifts or further hires as project advances.
